data.description:
# Fail closed when the proxy `/slots` detail is unavailable; remove the inaccurate count-based fallback

## Problem statement

The herdr downtime dispatcher can make a dispatch decision from the llama-proxy's
`available_slots` count when per-slot `/slots` detail is absent, empty
(`slots: []`) or flagged stale (`slots_stale: true`). That count is not
trustworthy (it can overcount the budget, and `ownerLeaseCount()` can report 0
on incomplete lease data), so a dispatch can land on a slot that is not actually
free. The operator has decided the dispatcher must **fail closed** — refuse to
dispatch — whenever the per-slot detail is unusable, and the inaccurate
count-based fallback must be removed.

## Users

- **Producer / operator** running overnight downtime dispatch: wants an
  assurance that the dispatcher never dispatches onto a leased or busy slot,
  even if that means no dispatch at all while the proxy cannot serve accurate
  per-slot detail.
  - *As a producer, I want the dispatcher to refuse to dispatch when the proxy
    cannot report per-slot detail, so that I never get two agents fighting over
    one slot.*
  - *As an operator, I want a distinct, observable "fail-closed" reason in the
    decision log and herdr header, so that I can tell "no dispatch because no
    trustworthy slots" apart from "no dispatch because there is no work".*
- **Downtime dispatcher** (system actor): must derive its free-slot budget from
  a single trusted source (the per-slot array), not from an unverifiable count.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. When the status payload has no usable per-slot detail — `slots` absent,
   `slots: []`, or `slots_stale: true` — the dispatcher does **not** dispatch,
   and records a **distinct** fail-closed reason in the decision log
   (`.worklog/downtime-coordination.log`) with a stable header token distinct
   from `slot-owner` / `contention`.
2. The count-based fallback functions (`countBasedFreeSlots`,
   `countBasedSpareCapacity`, `leaseReserve`, `ownerLeaseCount`) are **removed**
   from `packages/herdr/src/downtime-worker.ts`, with no remaining call sites
   (verified by `rg` and a clean TypeScript type-check).
3. `freeSlots` is **always** derived from the per-slot array
   (`countFreeUnownedSlots(usablePerSlotSlots)`); the raw `available_slots`
   count is never used as a dispatch budget, and `evaluateIdle()` / `tick()`
   cannot admit a dispatch when per-slot detail is unusable.
4. New regression tests pinned to the exact live payload from
   WL-0MUFP30T2003OX1F (`total_slots: 3`, `available_slots: 1`, `slots: []`,
   `slots_stale: true`, held owner lease, live dispatched pane) assert
   `dispatched === false` and the distinct fail-closed reason; superseded
   tests that asserted the removed count-based fallback are deleted or
   rewritten.
5. All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code
   comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries
   (`docs/dev/downtime-dispatcher.md`, `packages/herdr/README.md`) to state the
   fail-closed contract.
6. Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.

## Constraints

- **Fail closed only** — no fallback to the count, and no re-introduction of a
  cached last-good `/slots` response.
- **No proxy changes** — the llama-proxy is out of scope (tracked in
  llm-manager, e.g. LP-0MUFSVXID0039ZAQ); only the herdr consumer changes.
- **Do not weaken other gates** — contention depth, code freeze, review-queue,
  attempt cap and the per-slot ownership rules must behave exactly as today.
- **Observability is mandatory** — a total fail-closed stop must be diagnosable
  from the decision log and header token, not silent.
- **Operational acceptance** — on a proxy that cannot serve usable `/slots`
  detail, the dispatcher will perform **no** downtime dispatch; this is the
  operator's explicit intent (recorded in the work-item create comment).

## Existing state

- `usablePerSlotSlots(status)` returns `null` for `slots` absent, `[]`, or
  `slots_stale: true`; `null` is currently treated as "use the count-based
  path".
- `tick()` computes `freeSlots = perSlotSlots ? countFreeUnownedSlots(perSlotSlots) : status.available_slots`;
  `evaluateIdle()` falls back to `countBasedSpareCapacity()` /
  `isIdleStatus(available_slots)`; `tick()` mirrors that in its `slotOwned`
  qualifier via `ownerLeaseHeld && … && !countBasedSpare`.
- Four count-based helpers exist: `countBasedFreeSlots`, `countBasedSpareCapacity`,
  `leaseReserve`, `ownerLeaseCount` (the last also feeds the `slotOwned`
  qualifier). They were introduced by WL-0MUFP30T2003OX1F to avoid a stall.
- Dedicated tests for that feature live in the
  `stale/empty slots fallback + count-based spare capacity (WL-0MUFP30T2003OX1F)`
  describe block in `downtime-worker.test.ts` (~line 11917).
- `active_query` is parsed and required by `parseLlamaStatus` but is not used
  for idle/busy detection (the sole signal is `local_active_query`).

## Desired change

- Turn the "unusable per-slot detail" condition into a hard fail-closed
  precondition: no usable `slots` ⇒ no dispatch + distinct decision reason.
- Delete the four count-based helpers and every call site, including the
  `countBasedFree`/`slotOwned` branches in `tick()` and the count fallbacks in
  `evaluateIdle()`.
- Make `freeSlots` uniformly `countFreeUnownedSlots(usablePerSlotSlots)`.
- Remove the now-dead `active_query` field from the parser/type where it is
  provably unused (confirm the exact boundary during planning — the parser's
  fail-closed handling of genuinely required fields must be preserved).
- Update the decision-header token map and the two documentation files to
  describe the fail-closed contract; rewrite the feature's regression tests to
  pin the new behaviour.

## Key Files (predicted)

- `packages/herdr/src/downtime-worker.ts` — Remove `countBasedFreeSlots`,
  `countBasedSpareCapacity`, `leaseReserve`, `ownerLeaseCount`; convert
  `usablePerSlotSlots` into the fail-closed availability predicate; add the
  fail-closed gate + distinct reason in `tick()`/`evaluateIdle()`; derive
  `freeSlots` from `countFreeUnownedSlots` only; update `decisionHeaderToken`;
  drop the unused `active_query` field.
- `packages/herdr/src/downtime-worker.test.ts` — Rewrite the
  `(WL-0MUFP30T2003OX1F)` describe block; add live-payload regression tests
  asserting no dispatch + the fail-closed reason; remove tests of the deleted
  helpers.
- `docs/dev/downtime-dispatcher.md` — Update the stale/empty per-slot fallback
  sections (`~L669`, `~L998–L1056`) to the fail-closed contract.
- `packages/herdr/README.md` — Update the idle/per-slot fallback description
  (`~L450–L534`, `~L869–L879`) to the fail-closed contract.

## Risks and assumptions

### Risks

- **Silent total outage (behavioural).** On a proxy that serves unusable
  `/slots` detail, downtime dispatch stops entirely. Mitigation: the distinct
  fail-closed reason and header token make this visible; the change is
  intentional and operator-approved.
- **Observability gap.** If the new reason is rate-limited (10-minute window)
  or the header token is not mapped, the stop is less visible. Mitigation: map
  the token in `decisionHeaderToken` and assert it in a test.
- **Coverage loss.** Deleting the WL-0MUFP30T2003OX1F tests could remove the
  only regression guard for the original stall. Mitigation: AC4 pins the exact
  live payload as a fail-closed (no-dispatch) regression test.
- **Over-broad validation change.** Removing `active_query` from the parser
  could loosen fail-closed validation. Mitigation: confirm the exact field
  boundary during planning.
- **Scope creep.** The proxy-side cached-detail follow-up (LP-0MUFSVXID0039ZAQ)
  must remain in llm-manager, not be pulled into this item.

### Assumptions

- The live llama-proxy is expected to serve accurate per-slot detail; failing
  closed on older/stale proxies is acceptable and is the operator's explicit
  intent.
- The exact removal scope (the candidate list) is a planning decision; planning
  may identify further legacy code shown to be inaccurate.
- The name of the new fail-closed reason/token is a planning decision.

## Related work

- **WL-0MUFP30T2003OX1F** — introduced the count-based fallback (now to be
  removed) after a `slots: []` + `slots_stale: true` stall.
- **WL-0MU87ZGPP0029V28** — parent RCA on dispatcher stalls.
- **WL-0MT32F90V008UAD2** — spare-capacity dispatch feature (per-slot session).
- **WL-0MU8807BI008C9ME** — per-slot ownership gate (the other half of the
  stall fix).
- **WL-0MU8809SZ0022VZG** — count-based single-slot ownership protection.
- **WL-0MTYZXSLN008HZOW** — owner-lease + contention gates.
- **WL-0MU1DWXO600153OI** — precedent: removed the wrong (cumulative)
  contention signal.
- **WL-0MU2EP6JL006A1U3** — precedent: removed the inaccurate client-side
  running-pane cap.
- **LP-0MUFSVXID0039ZAQ** — proxy-side cached-detail follow-up (llm-manager,
  external).

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

The seed context (the work item's create comment and description) was
sufficient to draft this brief and contained the operator's explicit decision,
so no interactive interview round was required.

- **Q: Is failing closed — no dispatch when the proxy cannot serve usable
  `/slots` detail (including on pre-feature proxies) — the intended behaviour,
  accepting that downtime dispatch stops entirely in that case?**
  — **Answer (operator, 2026-10-07):** Yes. "The operator has now decided the
  correct behaviour is to fail closed instead." Source: WL-0MUXVPXAZ005RESW
  create comment and item description (Goal / Background / Assumptions).
- **Q: Are proxy-side changes in scope?**
  — **Answer (operator, seed context):** No. "Changes to the llama-proxy itself
  (tracked in llm-manager)" are out of scope; the proxy-side cached-detail
  follow-up is LP-0MUFSVXID0039ZAQ. Source: item description (Scope).
- **Q: Should a last-good `/slots` cache be re-introduced?**
  — **Answer (operator, seed context):** No. Re-introducing a cache of the last
  good `/slots` response is explicitly out of scope. Source: item description
  (Out of scope).

### Open questions

None. Remaining choices (the fail-closed reason name/token and the exact
`active_query` removal boundary) are planning-level decisions, not requirement
ambiguities.

## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **WL-0MUV0VEFW007ZBB7** – Raise default downtime idle threshold to 75s so active sessions reclaim freed slots before dispatch (completed)
- **WL-0MS68V35Y002RZRA** – Remove legacy wlCount setting from Herdr plugin (completed)
- **WL-0MPE9J3M6009JMN6** – Update documentation for Pi-based TUI (completed)

### Repository file matches
- `packages/herdr/README.md` — matched: absent, acceptable, acceptance, active, always (+149 more)
- `docs/dev/downtime-dispatcher.md` — matched: 0mu87zgpp0029v28, 0mufp30t2003ox1f, absent, active, always (+142 more)
- `CLI.md` — matched: absent, active, always, array, available (+114 more)

# Regression tests pinning the fail-closed contract (test-first)

## Goal

Pin the new fail-closed contract as automated regression tests before the
implementation lands, so the implementation is driven by the tests.

## Acceptance Criteria

- The `stale/empty slots fallback + count-based spare capacity (WL-0MUFP30T2003OX1F)` describe block in `packages/herdr/src/downtime-worker.test.ts` is rewritten: tests asserting count-based fallback dispatch are deleted/replaced.
- A regression test pinned to the exact live payload (`total_slots: 3`, `available_slots: 1`, `slots: []`, `slots_stale: true`, held owner lease, live dispatched pane) asserts `dispatched === false` and the distinct fail-closed reason `slots-unavailable`.
- Tests assert `evaluateIdle()` returns false when per-slot detail is absent, `[]`, or `slots_stale: true`.
- Tests assert the dispatch budget is never derived from `available_slots` (fail-closed budget).
- A test asserts `decisionHeaderToken('slots-unavailable') === 'no-slots'`.
- Tests are expected to fail (red) until the implementation children land; they pass once implementation is complete.

## Minimal Implementation

- Extend `packages/herdr/src/downtime-worker.test.ts`; rewrite the `(WL-0MUFP30T2003OX1F)` describe block (~L11917).

## Dependencies

None (test-first tracer bullet).

## Deliverables

- Updated `packages/herdr/src/downtime-worker.test.ts` with fail-closed regression tests.
data.title: Regression tests pinning the fail-closed contract

# Remove count-based helpers and rewire the free-slot budget

## Goal

Derive the dispatch budget from a single trusted source (the per-slot array)
and delete every inaccurate count-based path.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `countBasedFreeSlots`, `countBasedSpareCapacity`, `leaseReserve` and `ownerLeaseCount` are removed from `packages/herdr/src/downtime-worker.ts` with no remaining call sites (`rg`).
- The TypeScript type-check is clean (`tsc`) with the helpers removed.
- `freeSlots` is always `countFreeUnownedSlots(perSlotSlots)`; the raw `available_slots` count is never used as a dispatch budget.
- The `countBasedSpare`/global-owner fallback branch in `tick()`'s `slotOwned` qualifier (~L6179) is removed; `slotOwned` uses only the per-slot branch.
- `ownerPresent` in `recordDecision` is re-derived from a retained signal (`status.local_lease_active === true`).
- Every superseded fallback test is deleted or rewritten.

## Minimal Implementation

- Delete the four helpers (~L743/771/780/793) and their call sites in `tick()` (~L6099, L6172-L6185).
- Rewire `freeSlots` and `ownerPresent`.

## Dependencies

- WL-0MUYJOF5P001UKOH — regression tests.
- Blocked by the fail-closed gate child (F2) landing first.

## Deliverables

- Reduced `packages/herdr/src/downtime-worker.ts` with a single budget source.

# Fail-closed gate and distinct decision reason

## Goal

Make unusable per-slot detail (absent `slots`, `slots: []`, or
`slots_stale: true`) a hard fail-closed precondition: no dispatch, with a
distinct, observable decision reason.

## Acceptance Criteria

- When per-slot detail is unusable, `tick()` returns `dispatched: false` and records the distinct reason `slots-unavailable` via `recordDecision`.
- `decisionHeaderToken('slots-unavailable')` returns the stable token `no-slots`, distinct from `slot-owner` and `contention`.
- `evaluateIdle()` returns false whenever per-slot detail is unusable (it never admits a dispatch from `available_slots`).
- Contention depth, code freeze, review-queue, attempt-cap and per-slot ownership gates behave exactly as today (no weakening).
- The fail-closed refusal is observable in `.worklog/downtime-coordination.log` and the herdr header.

## Minimal Implementation

- Harden `usablePerSlotSlots()` (or add a boolean availability predicate) in `packages/herdr/src/downtime-worker.ts`.
- Add the fail-closed branch to `tick()` (~L6099) and `evaluateIdle()` (~L856).
- Extend `decisionHeaderToken()` (~L259) with `'slots-unavailable' -> 'no-slots'`.

## Dependencies

- WL-0MUYJOF5P001UKOH — regression tests pin the contract first.

## Deliverables

- Behaviour change plus the distinct reason/token in `packages/herdr/src/downtime-worker.ts`.

# Remove the dead active_query field

## Goal

Remove the provably-unused `active_query` field from the parser and type
without loosening validation of genuinely required fields.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `active_query` is removed from the `LlamaStatus` interface and from the object returned by `parseLlamaStatus()`.
- The `typeof o.active_query !== 'boolean'` required-field guard is dropped; every other required and optional-field guard is preserved and pinned by parse tests.
- `local_active_query` (the sole busy signal) is untouched.
- Fixtures and tests that set `active_query` compile and pass; `tsc` is clean.

## Minimal Implementation

- Edit `packages/herdr/src/downtime-worker.ts` (~L566 type, ~L1077 parser guard, ~L1189 return).
- Update `packages/herdr/src/downtime-worker.fixtures.ts` and affected test fixtures.

## Dependencies

- WL-0MUYJOF5P001UKOH — regression tests.

## Deliverables

- Dead field removed; parser guards preserved.
data.title: Remove the dead active_query field

# Update documentation to the fail-closed contract

## Goal

Make all related documentation and code comments describe the fail-closed
contract and remove references to the deleted count-based fallback.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `docs/dev/downtime-dispatcher.md` (stale/empty per-slot sections, ~L669 and ~L998-L1056) states the fail-closed contract: no usable per-slot detail means no dispatch, with the `slots-unavailable` reason / `no-slots` token.
- `packages/herdr/README.md` (~L450-L534, ~L869-L879) describes the fail-closed idle/per-slot behaviour.
- No stale references to a count-based fallback or `available_slots` dispatch budget remain in either file.
- Updated code comments in `packages/herdr/src/downtime-worker.ts` match the new behaviour.

## Minimal Implementation

- Edit the two documentation files and the relevant code comments.

## Dependencies

- The fail-closed gate child and the helper-removal child must land first.

## Deliverables

- Updated `docs/dev/downtime-dispatcher.md`, `packages/herdr/README.md`, and code comments.

# Planning Complete

Fail-closed decomposition for the herdr downtime dispatcher. Five children created in test-first dependency order; the count-based fallback and the count budget source are removed, replaced by a hard fail-closed gate with the distinct reason `slots-unavailable` (header token `no-slots`).

## Features

| # | Feature | ID | Type | Priority | Depends on |
|---|---------|----|------|----------|------------|
| F1 | Regression tests pinning the fail-closed contract | WL-0MUYJOF5P001UKOH | task | high | — |
| F2 | Fail-closed gate and distinct decision reason | WL-0MUYJOPWT005PS6K | feature | high | F1 |
| F3 | Remove count-based helpers and rewire free-slot budget | WL-0MUYJOOK70099NV0 | task | high | F1, F2 |
| F4 | Remove the dead `active_query` field | WL-0MUYJORO70095TJZ | task | medium | F1 |
| F5 | Update documentation to the fail-closed contract | WL-0MUYJOSZB000IRJH | docs | medium | F2, F3 |

## Planning decisions (operator-approved)

- **Q1 — Approve the 5-feature plan?** Answer (operator, 2026-10-07): **Approved** ("LGTM").
- **Q2 — Name of the new fail-closed reason / header token?** Answer (operator, 2026-10-07): **(a) reason `slots-unavailable`, header token `no-slots`.** Chosen to be short, greppable and distinct from `slot-owner` / `contention`.
- **Q3 — `active_query` removal boundary?** Answer (operator, 2026-10-07): **(a) full removal** — drop the field from `LlamaStatus` and the parser output and drop its required-field guard, preserving every other fail-closed guard.

Planning decision recorded without an interview round: F3 re-derives `ownerPresent` in `recordDecision` from `status.local_lease_active === true` (the only remaining consumer of the removed `ownerLeaseCount` helper).

## AC coverage mapping (manual)

| Parent AC | Covered by |
|-----------|------------|
| AC1 fail-closed + distinct reason | F2 |
| AC2 helper removal + no call sites | F3 |
| AC3 `freeSlots` from per-slot only | F2, F3 |
| AC4 live-payload regression tests | F1 |
| AC5 documentation updated | F5 |
| AC6 full suite passes | F1 (suite verification) |

The `tree_coverage` helper returns `proceed` for this item. Note: the helper only parses markdown bullets, so it does not extract this item's numbered AC list; the mapping above was verified manually instead of reflowing the seed description.

## Plan: changelog

- 2026-10-07 — Plan session: created F1–F5 children with `intake_complete`; wired dependency edges (F2←F1, F3←F1+F2, F4←F1, F5←F2+F3); ran six automated review stages + AC coverage review; recorded the three operator-approved planning decisions.
